normalized_claim: Therapeutic plasma exchange regimens change epigenetic biological-age clocks relative to sham at the intermediate assessment in older adults.
exposure_or_intervention: therapeutic plasma exchange with or without IVIG
population_or_model: 42 generally healthy adults completing the trial

estimand_or_contrast.statement: Between-group difference in change from baseline in epigenetic age acceleration for each TPE regimen versus sham.
estimand_or_contrast.effect_measure_or_logical_contrast: Wilcoxon exact comparison with FDR correction across 36 clocks

assumption_judgments.assessment: Sequential first-come-first-served filling is predictable nonrandom assignment despite randomized terminology.
A simulated TPE sham was used as the between-group comparator.
Adherence by assigned regimen was not fully reported in the inspected main-text sections.
Forty-two of 44 enrolled participants completed the study.
Most biological clocks differed between groups at baseline.
Active regimens were compared with sham on change in age acceleration.
FDR correction was used for between-group clock comparisons, and absence of a time-point-3 effect was reported.

diagnostics.name: FDR across epigenetic clocks
diagnostics.result_or_role: Between-group clock comparisons were corrected; nominal within-group trends were also described.
